items.question: Do you accept guest essays?
items.answer: Yes — we publish reader essays every season. Send a short pitch first.

items.question: Can I reuse your photographs?
items.answer: Only with written permission. Most are licensed from the photographers, not owned by us.

items.question: How often do you publish?
items.answer:
Two or three pieces a month, plus the seasonal issue.

  • Guides: monthly
  • Essays: seasonal

items.question: Do you run ads?
items.answer: No. The journal is funded by members.

items.question: How do I cancel my membership?
items.answer: From your account page, at any time.
